LocalModelPilot 0.1.0 (macOS, original tool)
- Requires: macOS, Python 3.11+ (/usr/bin/python3), existing llama-server binary.
- Run UI: open dist/LocalModelPilot.app  (or: ./run.sh web)
- CLI: ./run.sh scan | models | serve -m <model.gguf> | status | stop
- Config: ~/Library/Application Support/LocalModelPilot/config.json
- Logs (capped, rate-limited): ~/Library/Application Support/LocalModelPilot/localmodelpilot.log
This tool reuses local model files (e.g. ~/AI-Models) and llama-server; it does not bundle weights.
